title: PRESSER | Joshua Dye - Wofford Preview (11-17-26)
text: I see him. >> I guess uh Josh, just for you, what's this season kind of been like just kind of, you know, waiting, buying your time, waiting for a chance like Saturday? >> Um just embracing that process, you know. Um coming into this program, I I knew we had a bunch of dudes. I knew that we're going to be the strongest running back group, so just waiting for my time to come up and just play. Josh, after after what you did last season and putting up putting up crazy stats, what what made you kind of have that belief that, hey, I I can do this at the SEC and and I can play well up here? >> I mean, I'm not the type of person that judges the level of play that you're at. You know, if you're a baller, you're a baller. Um, you can do that at any level. It's really just confidence and the momentum that you have. So in my mind there's no doubt that I can do it at the next level and the level after that it's just you know [laughter] >> could you take us through that touchdown run against OU >> uh touchdown run um really I seen I was pressing COC and I seen the mic come I just did a little business and score. What have the last couple of days been like for this team following that that tough loss? >> Um, really just embracing the process, embracing the suck, you know, because no one wants to lose and then come back the next day. But we are encouraged every single day to to keep pushing and strive for the best. And sometimes it gets gritty, sometimes it gets frustrating to have those little setbacks, but I think that we push forward every single day to be the best individual and the best teammate that we can be.
